description: D2: the first time the Stormcaller is grounded by his own lightning (Events.titan_grounded): what happened and how to make it happen again.
text: His own lightning ran down through him: standing deep in the water, he is grounded - down on a knee. Strike now. Draw him into the deep pool and let his bolts fall on the water near him; keep out of it yourself, or stand where it is shallow for you.
